paragraphs.text: Most people understand speech better when they can see the speaker’s face, even if they are not aware of it. In noisy places, watching the lips can improve understanding as much as turning the volume up considerably.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Professional lip-readers, who often have hearing loss themselves, can follow much of a conversation, but no one can read every word. Many sounds, such as p and b, look identical on the lips, so lip-readers rely heavily on context to guess what has been said.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Face masks, which became common in recent years, made communication harder for people with hearing loss. Some manufacturers responded by producing masks with a clear window over the mouth.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Researchers are now training computers to read lips from video. Early systems perform well with a limited vocabulary, but they still struggle with the variety of accents found in everyday speech.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Lip-reading classes are offered in many towns, and teachers say that regular practice with friends and family is the most effective way to improve.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: In noisy places, watching the lips can improve understanding

explanation.en: “In noisy places, watching the lips can improve understanding” → noisy. An adjective is needed before “places”.
explanation.kk: «In noisy places, watching the lips can improve understanding» → noisy. «in … places» тіркесіне сын есім керек.
explanation.ru: «In noisy places, watching the lips can improve understanding» → noisy. После «in … places» нужно прилагательное.

items.quote: Many sounds, such as p and b, look identical on the lips
items.prompt: some sounds look 2 ____ on the lips

explanation.en: “look identical on the lips” → identical. Copy it exactly: a spelling mistake scores zero.
explanation.kk: «look identical on the lips» → identical. Сөзді дәл жазыңыз: емле қатесі есептелмейді.
explanation.ru: «look identical on the lips» → identical. Пишите слово точно: ошибка в написании не засчитывается.

items.quote: lip-readers rely heavily on context to guess what has been said
items.prompt: they depend on 3 ____ to fill the gaps

explanation.en: Because some sounds look the same, lip-readers “rely heavily on context to guess what has been said”. “Depend on” = “rely on” → context.
explanation.kk: Кейбір дыбыстар бірдей көрінгендіктен, оқушылар «rely heavily on context to guess what has been said». «Depend on» = «rely on», жауап context.
explanation.ru: Раз некоторые звуки выглядят одинаково, чтецы «rely heavily on context to guess what has been said». «Depend on» = «rely on», ответ context.

items.quote: masks with a clear window over the mouth

explanation.en: Manufacturers made “masks with a clear window over the mouth” so the lips can be seen. Answer: window.
explanation.kk: Өндірушілер ерін көрінуі үшін «masks with a clear window over the mouth» шығарған. Жауап window.
explanation.ru: Производители выпустили «masks with a clear window over the mouth», чтобы были видны губы. Ответ window.

items.quote: they still struggle with the variety of accents found in everyday speech

explanation.en: “struggle with the variety of accents” → accents, plural. “Vocabulary” is what the systems handle well.
explanation.kk: «struggle with the variety of accents» → accents, көпше түрде. «Vocabulary» — жүйелер жақсы меңгеретін нәрсе.
explanation.ru: «struggle with the variety of accents» → accents, во множественном числе. «Vocabulary» — то, с чем системы справляются.
